properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 2:14PM MST until September 13 at 5:15PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Antelope Canyon in north central Arizona...

* Until 515 PM MST /615 PM MDT/.

* At 214 PM MST /314 PM MDT/, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms
producing heavy rain from Le Chee to Antelope Canyon. Flash
flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams and
normally dry washes.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Page, Lower Antelope Canyon, Owl Canyon, LeChee, Rattlesnake
Canyon, Mountain Sheep Canyon and Upper Antelope Canyon.

This includes the following slot canyons...
Lower Antelope Canyon, Owl Canyon and Rattlesnake Canyon.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Honey Draw and Antelope Creek.
properties.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 5:15 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

Southern Niagara County in western New York...

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

properties.description:

miles north of Cortland, moving southeast at 55 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Pompey, Otisco, Cuyler, Tully, Deruyter, Fabius, La Fayette, De
Ruyter, Apulia, and Sheds.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's leading
killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close enough to
be struck by lightning.

Heavy rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to flash
flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 13 at 4:50PM MDT until September 13 at 5:15PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
At 450 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 16 miles north of
Conchas Dam, or 15 miles southwest of Mosquero, moving northeast at
10 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Mainly rural areas of West Central Harding and Northeastern San
Miguel Counties.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Accumulations of small hail on roads can create very slick and
hazardous driving conditions.
